title: Three more projects in the community directory
summary:
Three community projects joined the directory, while project sorting, an affiliate listing, and Mistral model descriptions got a tidy-up.

NailsGen brings AI nail-art designs, imggen.top adds a Chinese-language FLUX image generator, and WebGeniusAI generates HTML websites with Pollinations visuals.

The former “For Teens” category is now “Featured.” Projects sort by priority and GitHub stars, the 🆕 marker applies only to submissions from the past 15 days, and DesmondBot’s listing points to its updated URL.

The AI UX-writing tool was added with matching terms for brand voice, copywriting, and product content.
